slots.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.
